goal: Map each Schedule 3.14 item through the competing indemnity structures and file the reconciliation memo under the commissioned filename.
prompt:
You represent Trellis BioWorks (sell-side) on Project Lattice. Before the next negotiation session, the deal team needs a reconciliation of the disclosed litigation and IP matters against the indemnity architecture on the table. First query the matter file to locate, and then read in full, each of: (1) the share purchase agreement Article VIII indemnification provisions, execution draft v4 (deductible, cap, and survival baseline); (2) the second-turn markup of Article VIII from Halberd's outside counsel (tipping basket, raised cap, and special-indemnity ask); (3) the Trellis deal team's privileged approved indemnity positions memo; and (4) the Trellis disclosure schedule covering litigation and intellectual property matters. Then draft a disclosure reconciliation memorandum that: takes each disclosed schedule item in turn (by item number, matter name, and status); states its quantified exposure where the schedule supplies a dollar amount and characterizes the risk where it does not; analyzes how each item would be treated under (a) the v4 deductible-and-cap structure, (b) the Halberd markup including its tipping basket and special indemnity, and (c) the approved-positions fallback; states the aggregate quantified exposure of the pending disclosed matters; and flags which disclosed item the approved positions require excluding from any special indemnity and why. Create the deliverable with documents_create using title exactly trellis-spa-disclosure-reconciliation-memo.docx and doc_type exactly deliverable. Use only dollar amounts that appear in the documents.

PRIVILEGED AND CONFIDENTIAL — DISCLOSURE RECONCILIATION MEMORANDUM (PROJECT LATTICE)
RE: SCHEDULE 3.14 MATTERS MAPPED AGAINST THE v4 DRAFT, THE HALBERD MARKUP, AND THE APPROVED POSITIONS

Item 1 — TTAB Opposition No. 91-284772 (Lumenor Devices B.V. v. Trellis; TRELLIGEN mark; pending). No damages claimed; exposure is refusal of registration and rebranding cost, unquantified. Under v4: any resulting Losses run through the $400,000 deductible and $12,000,000 (10%) cap. Under the Halberd markup: swept into the uncapped Section 8.2(d) special indemnity outside basket and cap. Under approved positions: eligible for the limited special indemnity (within the $2,500,000 aggregate cap, 24-month survival).

Item 2 — Bexley Clinical Partners LLC demand (pending, pre-litigation): quantified at $1,850,000. Under v4: exceeds the $400,000 deductible, leaving $1,450,000 recoverable within the $12,000,000 cap if liability were established. Under the Halberd markup: first-dollar recovery — the claim alone tips the proposed $250,000 tipping basket, and the special indemnity would make it recoverable outside any cap. Under approved positions: eligible for the limited special indemnity, counting against the $2,500,000 aggregate cap.

Item 3 — OSHA Citation No. 1829445 (resolved; $46,500 penalty paid 17 March 2026). A closed matter with no remaining exposure. The approved positions require that any special indemnity expressly EXCLUDE resolved matters, including this item: covering a settled citation would hand Buyer a costless claim lane and is out of policy. Under v4 it is disclosed and therefore not a rep breach.

AGGREGATE. The pending disclosed matters carry quantified exposure of $1,850,000 (Item 2), plus the unquantified rebranding risk of Item 1. Both fit within the approved $2,500,000 special-indemnity cap, which supports offering the limited rider while rejecting the uncapped ask and the tipping-basket conversion (approved basket floor: $300,000 true deductible; markup ask: $250,000 tipping).
